title: Deepest Signal

story.briefing: Charge accumulates down every branch of the lattice. Find the branch that delivers the most from the trunk to a tip.
story.success: Strongest branch found. The Core draws from it.

description: A tree is given as an array where the node at index i has its left child at index 2i+1 and its right child at index 2i+2. A null entry means there is no node there, and nothing exists beneath it. Return the largest sum obtainable along a path from the root down to a leaf — a leaf being a node with no children. An empty tree returns 0. Values may be negative, and the path must run all the way to a leaf.

examples.explanation: The only leaf is -2, so the path must include it.

hints: The best sum from a node is its own value plus the better of its two subtree results — but only where a subtree actually exists.
A node with one child is not a leaf, so you must not treat the missing side as a zero. Doing so lets a path stop early, which the second example is built to catch.
Work bottom-up over the array, from the last index back to 0. A leaf holds its own value. A node with children holds its value plus the larger of whichever child results exist.
